Yes, the December 1 go-live is still on track — Priya confirmed as much, provided the end-to-end test happens the week of Nov 23 [1]. The contract (signed Oct 20) fixes December 1, 2026 as the go-live date, and Fernhill's change board approved the Kestrel application on Nov 17 [2].

What's done:
- SP-initiated SAML login merged behind the `saml_sso` flag, with SHA-256 minimum enforcement [2] / [9 in earlier results – GitHub PR #1288]
- Fernhill's IdP metadata and signing certificate received and loaded on staging; IdP-initiated login works [2]

What's left before Dec 1:
1. **Fernhill must switch their assertion signing from RSA-SHA1 to RSA-SHA256** — our platform rejects SHA-1 by design. This needs their change board approval at their Nov 24 meeting, to be applied that evening [1][2]
2. **Joint end-to-end test session** scheduled for Wednesday Nov 25 with Helen Marsh, using their test account (kestrel.test@fernhillbank.example) [1]
3. **Admin settings page copy still needs Priya's review** (page itself is on staging) [2]
4. **"Require SSO" toggle + JIT provisioning** to be validated in the test, so @fernhillbank.example users are forced onto SSO [2]

The main risk is the signing-algorithm change going through their board in time for the Nov 25 test; Helen expects it will be approved and applied Nov 24 evening [1].
